menu.event:
local eventScreen = component:E("EventScreen")
eventScreen.bg.TopLeft("xOffset"):SetFloat(-10*game.windowScaleY()) eventScreen.bg.TopLeft("yOffset"):SetFloat(15*game.windowScaleY())
eventScreen.bg.TopRight("xOffset"):SetFloat(-10*game.windowScaleY()) eventScreen.bg.TopRight("yOffset"):SetFloat(15*game.windowScaleY())
eventScreen.bg.BottomRight("xOffset"):SetFloat(-44*game.windowScaleY()) eventScreen.bg.BottomRight("yOffset"):SetFloat(-7*game.windowScaleY())
eventScreen.onContinue = function(e) if game.existingClubboxAct() == 0 or game.inAdminViewMode() then if game.getPopUp() ~= "clubbox_act_select" then game.pushPopUp("clubbox_act_select") end else game.goToClubbox(0,0) end end
